mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of corporate cash flows, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) contraction signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST monthly change < -5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to produce a statistically significant negative alpha (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for four consecutive months, combined with accelerating average hourly earnings growth (proxied by PAYEMS trend), signals a tight labor market that pushes up input costs and inflation, which in turn reduces equity valuations via higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0% for 4 consecutive months AND PAYEMS 3-month change > 0.5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered periods, or the mechanism fails in more than 50% of episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp reduction in the federal funds rate below 2% during a recession (UNRATE > 5%) signals an aggressive monetary easing, which boosts risk appetite and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails in more than 40% of recession triggers.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.7% for five consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS monthly change > 0.7% for 5 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during triggered periods, or the mechanism fails in more than 45% of episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a fall in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE monthly change > 0.3% AND PAYEMS monthly change < -1.0%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 4% for six consecutive months, combined with a flat or declining industrial production (INDPRO), signals persistent inflation with weak growth, which erodes real corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 104 for 6 consecutive months AND INDPRO monthly change <= 0%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails in more than 50% of stagflation triggers.
